words.en: A class is a group of pupils or students who are taught together.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: He passed the exam with high marks.
words.en: An exam is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.tr:
n. 试验；测验；
v. 试验；测试；
words.ex: The scientist ran a test to see if the drug works.
words.ex_cn: 科学家进行了一次试验，以查看这种药物是否有效。
words.en: A test is a series of questions or problems that is used to measure a person's ability or understanding of something.

words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.ex: I write letters to my penfriend in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 我给我在加拿大的笔友写信。
words.en: A penfriend is someone you write friendly letters to on a regular basis, especially someone in another country whom you have never met.

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.ex: I got your message this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上收到了你的消息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.ex: He got a phone call from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他接到了他妈妈的电话。
words.en: A phone call is a conversation that you have with someone by telephone.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.ex: I read the news every morning.
words.en: News is information about recent events or happenings, especially as reported by newspapers, radio, television, or online media.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.ex: He watches his favorite tv show every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看自己最喜欢的电视节目。
words.en: A series of programmes broadcast on television, often with a continuing storyline.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.ex: He watches a movie every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上都看电影。
words.en: A movie is a story or event recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoon every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通片。
words.en: A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or a film made using animation techniques.

words.tr: n. 故事；小说；轶事；假话；
words.ex: He told a funny story to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.ex: He sings a happy song every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上唱一首快乐的歌。
words.en: A song is a piece of music with words that is sung.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.en: A piano is a large musical instrument with a keyboard. When you press the keys, small hammers hit strings inside the piano, which produce musical notes.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.ex: He took a photo with his camera.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的摄像机拍了一张照片。
words.en: A camera is a piece of equipment that is used for taking photographs, making films, or producing television pictures.

words.ex: He took a photo of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的照片。
words.en: A photo is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.tr: n. 绘画；油画； v. 刷油漆；用颜料画；“paint”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves painting in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间绘画。
words.en: A painting is a picture which someone has painted.

words.ex: The color of the sky is blue.
words.en: Color is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light.

words.tr:
adj. 红的；
n. 红色；
words.ex: The apple is red.
words.en: Red is the colour of blood or of ripe tomatoes.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.tr:
adj. 黄色的；
n. 黄色；
words.ex: The banana is yellow.
words.en: Yellow is the color of lemons, butter, or the middle part of an egg. It is one of the three primary colors.

words.tr:
adj. 黑色的；
n. 黑色；
words.ex: He wore a black shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件黑色的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is black is of the darkest colour that there is, the colour of the sky at night when there is no light at all.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.tr:
adj. 褐色的；棕色的；
n. 褐色；棕色；
words.ex: The brown dog slept on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 那只褐色的狗躺在地板上睡觉。
words.en: Brown is a color that is a mixture of red, yellow, and black. It is the color of earth, wood, and many other natural things.

words.tr:
n. 灰色；
adj. 灰色的；暗淡的；
words.ex: The sky turned gray before the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨前，天空变成了灰色。
words.en: Gray is an intermediate color between black and white, often associated with gloom or dullness.

words.tr:
adj. 粉红色的；
n. 粉红色；
words.ex: The flower is pink.
words.en: Pink is a pale red color that is named after the flower of the same name. It is often associated with femininity and romance.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.tr:
n. 金；金币；金黄色；
adj. 金色的；
words.ex: He bought a gold ring for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为妻子买了一枚金戒指。
words.en: Gold is a valuable, yellow-colored metal that is used for making jewelry and as an international currency.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.tr:
n. 形状；身材；定形；
v. 塑造；
words.ex: The shape of the table is round.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子的形状是圆形的。
words.en: The shape of an object is its external form or outline, which can be seen and felt.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.ex: The number on the door is 5.
words.en: A number is a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity.

words.ex: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
words.en: Zero is the number 0; nothing.

words.ex: I have one apple.
words.en: One is used to refer to the first and lowest whole number, often used to indicate a single person or thing.

words.ex: I have two apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of one and one; one less than three.

words.ex: I have three apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of one and two; one more than two.

words.ex: I have four apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of three and one; one more than three.

words.ex: I have five apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of two and three; one more than four, or half of ten.

words.ex: He has six apples on the table.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of three and two; one more than five, or four less than ten; 6.

words.ex: He has seven apples in his bag.
words.en: Seven is the number 7.

words.ex: He has eight apples in his bag.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of two and four; one more than seven, or two less than ten; 8.

words.ex: He has nine apples in his bag.
words.en: The number after eight and before ten.

words.ex: He has ten apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and two; one more than nine; 10.

words.ex: There are a hundred students in the hall.
words.en: The number 100; the number that is equal to ten times ten.

words.tr:
num. 一千；
n. 千；千个；
words.ex: There are a thousand stars in the night sky.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of a hundred and ten; 1,000.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.tr:
adj. 第二的；
n. 第二；秒；片刻；
adv. 第二；
words.ex: He got the second prize in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第二名。
words.en: Second is used to describe something that is next after the first in order, rank, importance, or occurrence.

words.tr:
adj. 第三的；
n. 三分之一；第三；
adv. 第三；
words.ex: He finished in third place.
words.en: Coming after the second and just before the fourth in position.

words.tr:
adj. 第四的；
n. 第四个；
adv. 第四；
words.ex: He finished in fourth place.
words.en: The fourth item in a series is the one that you count as number four.

words.tr:
adj. 第五的；
n. 五分之一；第五；
adv. 第五；
words.ex: He finished in fifth place.
words.en: The fifth item in a series is the one that you count as number five.

words.tr:
adj. 下一个的；
adv. 随后；
pron. 下一个；
words.ex: This is the next bus to the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是下一班去城市的公交车。
words.en: Coming immediately after the present one in order, sequence, or time.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.tr:
adv. 然后；接下来；那时；
adj. 当时的；那时的；
words.ex: I ate breakfast, then I went to school.
words.ex_cn: 我吃了早餐，然后去了学校。
words.en: At that time; next in order of time; in that case.

words.ex: He will arrive soon.
words.en: If something is going to happen soon, it will happen after a short time. If something happened soon after a particular time or event, it happened a short time after it.

words.ex: He always eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: At all times; on all occasions.

words.ex: She usually walks to school.
words.en: Under normal conditions; generally.

words.ex: He often goes to the park after school.
words.en: Many times; frequently.

words.ex: I sometimes walk to school.
words.en: At times; occasionally.

words.ex: He seldom eats fast food.
words.en: If something seldom happens, it happens only occasionally.

words.ex: He has never been to Japan.
words.en: At no time in the past or future; on no occasion; not ever.

words.ex: He called me again yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天又给我打了电话。
words.en: Once more; another time.

words.ex: He has already finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他已经完成了他的作业。
words.en: You use already to say that something has happened, or that something had happened before the moment you are referring to.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.ex: Here is your book.
words.en: in or at this place or position

words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.en: Used to indicate the place where someone or something is or where something happens.

words.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在任何地方都找不到我的钥匙。
words.en: in, at, or to any place, when it does not matter where

words.tr: adv. 到处；处处；各个地方；所有地方；
words.ex: She looked everywhere for her keys.
words.en: in or to all places

words.tr:
prep. 在（或向）…内；
n. 内部；里面；
adv. 在（或向）里面；
adj. 内部的；里面的；
words.ex: The keys are inside the drawer.
words.en: The inside of something is the part that is normally enclosed or hidden by its outer surface.

words.tr:
prep. 在...外；
n. 外面；外边；外部；
adv. 在外面；
adj. 外面的；外界的；
words.ex: The cat is sitting outside the house.
words.en: The outer side or surface of something; not inside a building; external to a particular place or thing.

words.ex: He went upstairs to sleep.
words.en: If you go upstairs in a building, you go up a staircase towards a higher floor.

words.ex: He went downstairs to get a drink.
words.en: If you go downstairs in a building, you go down a staircase towards the ground floor.

words.tr:
n. 北方；
adj. 北方的；
adv. 在北方；
words.ex: The wind is coming from the north.
words.en: The direction that is on your left when you are facing the rising sun.

words.tr:
n. 南方；
adj. 南方的；
adv. 在南方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east and sets in the south.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起，在南方落下。
words.en: The south is the direction which is on your right when you are looking towards the direction where the sun rises.

words.tr:
n. 东方；
adj. 东方的；
adv. 在东方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun rises at the equinoxes, on the right-hand side of a person facing north.

words.tr:
n. 西方；
adj. 西方的；
adv. 在西方；
words.ex: The address is 1071 West Street.
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun sets at the equinoxes, on the left-hand side of a person facing north, or the part of the horizon lying in this direction.

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.tr:
adv. 远；极；
adj. 较远的；遥远的；
words.ex: He ran far from the house.
words.en: At, to, or by a great distance (used to indicate the extent to which one thing is distant from another).

words.tr:
prep. 在…上面；
adj. 上述的；
adv. 在上面；
words.ex: The book is above the table.
words.en: In or to a higher place than something else; over.

words.tr:
prep. 在…下面；低于；少于；
adv. 在下面；
words.ex: The cat is below the table.
words.en: If something is below something else, it is in a lower position.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之前；先于；
conj. 在…以前；
adv. 以前；之前；
words.ex: She ate breakfast before school.
words.ex_cn: 她在上学之前吃了早餐。
words.en: Earlier in time; previously.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之后；
adv. 以后；后来；
words.ex: I will call you after dinner.
words.en: In addition to its use as a preposition meaning 'behind in place or time,' 'after' can also function as an adverb to indicate a subsequent time or event.

words.tr:
n. 前面；前线；
adj. 前面的；
words.ex: The front of the house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 房子的前面有一个大花园。
words.en: The front is the part of something that faces forward or is the most important or prominent part.

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.ex: The book is in the bag.
words.en: Used to indicate location or position within something.

words.ex: He is on the bus.
words.en: used to indicate position above and in contact with a surface, or to indicate the topic of discussion, or to indicate the time when something happens, or to indicate the means by which something is done, or to indicate the basis for something, or to indicate the state of something

words.ex: The cat is under the table.
words.en: In or to a position below or beneath something.

words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.ex: He is among the best students in class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最好的学生之一。
words.en: If you are among a group of things or people, you are surrounded by them or part of them.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.ex: He slept during the movie.
words.en: Throughout the course or duration of (a period of time).

words.tr:
prep. 自…以后；从…以来；
conj. 因为；由于；既然；从…以后；
adv. 此后；后来；
words.ex: He has lived here since 2020.
words.ex_cn: 他自2020年以来一直住在这里。
words.en: From a past time until now; because; as a result of the fact that.

words.tr:
prep. 到…时；直到…为止；
conj. 到…时；直到…为止；
words.ex: He waited until the bus came.
words.en: Up to the time of; before (a specified time).

words.ex: He was late because the bus was slow.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车很慢。
words.en: You use 'because' when stating the reason for something.

words.tr:
adv. 如此；这么；很；也
conj. 所以
words.ex: I am so tired after school.
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.tr:
conj. 虽然；尽管；然而；
adv. 虽然；尽管；可是；
words.ex: Though it was raining, he went out.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use though to introduce a statement in a subordinate clause which contrasts with the statement in the main clause. You often use though to introduce a fact which you regard as less important than the fact in the main clause.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.ex: If it rains, we will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
words.en: You use if in conditional sentences to introduce the circumstances in which an event or situation might happen, might be happening, or might have happened.

words.tr:
conj. 在…的时候；
adv. 什么时候；
words.ex: I eat breakfast when I wake up.
words.en: You use when to ask about the time that something happened or will happen.

words.tr:
conj. 当…的时候；尽管；然而；
n. 一段时间；一会儿；
words.ex: I read a book while I waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我等公交车的时候读了一本书。
words.en: While is used to introduce a clause in which you mention something that happens at the same time as something else, or to introduce a clause that contrasts with something else that you have mentioned.

words.ex: Where is the book?
words.en: You use where to ask questions about the place or position of someone or something, or to indicate the place or position of someone or something.

words.ex: How do you make coffee?
words.en: In what way or manner; by what means.

words.ex: What is your name?
words.en: You use 'what' in questions when you ask for specific information about something that you do not know.

words.ex: Who is that girl?
words.en: You use who in questions to ask about the name, identity, or function of one or more people.

words.ex: Whom did you invite to the party?
words.ex_cn: 你邀请了谁来参加派对？
words.en: You use whom in questions when you ask about the name or identity of a person or group of people.

words.ex: The boy whose bag is red is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 那个书包是红色的男孩是我弟弟。
words.en: You use whose to ask about the person that something belongs to or is associated with.

words.tr:
pron. 哪个；
adj. 哪个的；
words.ex: Which book do you want to read?
words.en: You use which in questions when there are two or more possible answers or alternatives.

words.tr:
pron. 这个；
adj. 这；
adv. 这样；这个；这么；
words.ex: This is my book.
words.en: You use 'this' to refer to a person or thing that is near you, especially when you touch them or point to them.

words.tr:
conj. 那（引导从句）；
pron. 那儿；那里；
adj. 那；那个；那样的；
adv. 那个；那么；那样；
words.ex: I know that he is coming tomorrow.
words.en: Used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard by the speaker.

words.tr: pron. 这些；“this”的复数； adj. 这些的；
words.ex: These books are on the table.
words.en: You use these at the beginning of noun groups to refer to someone or something that you have already mentioned or identified.

words.tr: pron. 那些；“that”的复数； adj. 那些的；
words.ex: Those books are on the table.
words.en: You use those to refer to people or things which have already been mentioned or which are already known about.

words.tr:
adj. 一些；某些；
pron. 有些；若干；
words.ex: I need some water.
words.en: used to refer to an unspecified amount or number of something

words.tr:
adj. 任何的；
pron. 任何；
adv. 稍微；
words.ex: You can choose any book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从书架上选任何一本书。
words.en: You use any to refer to one or some of a thing or number of things, no matter how much or how many.

words.tr:
adj. 许多的；
pron. 许多人或物；
words.ex: Many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of.

words.tr:
adv. 非常地；
adj. 多；许多；
pron. 许多；
words.ex: She is much happier now.
words.en: A large amount or to a great degree.

words.tr:
adj. 很少；不多；
pron. 很少人；一些；
n. 几个；
words.ex: Few people came to the meeting.
words.en: A few means a small number of things or people. When you say there are a few of something, you mean there are not many of them.

words.ex: There is little water left in the bottle.
words.en: Small in size, amount, or degree (often used to convey an appealing diminutiveness or express an affectionate or dismissive attitude).

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.tr:
adj. 又一个的；另一个的；
pron. 又一；另一；
words.ex: I need another cup of tea.
words.en: used to refer to an additional person or thing of the same type as one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: He eats apples every day.
words.en: Each and all of the members of a group or set without exception.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.tr:
adj. 两者的；
pron. 两者；
conj. 不仅…而且...；
words.ex: Both books are on the table.
words.en: You use both to refer to two things or people together.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；
adv. 全部地；
n. 全部；
words.ex: All the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都通过了考试。
words.en: All is used to indicate that every part of something or every one of a group is included or involved.

words.ex: None of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 没有一个学生通过了考试。
words.en: not any; no amount or part of something

words.ex: He has the same book as me.
words.ex_cn: 他有一本和我一样的书。
words.en: If two or more things, actions, or qualities are the same, or if one is the same as another, they are very like each other in some way.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.ex: The book is interesting.
words.en: If something is interesting, it attracts your attention, because it is unusual, exciting, or has lots of ideas.

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.ex: This math problem is easy.
words.en: If a job or action is easy, you can do it without difficulty because it is not complicated and causes no problems.

words.tr:
adj. 极好的；大的；伟大的；
adv. 很好地；
words.ex: This is a great movie!
words.en: If you describe someone or something as great, you approve of them or admire them.

words.ex: The concert was wonderful.
words.en: If you describe something or someone as wonderful, you think they are extremely good.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；美好的；
words.ex: The weather today is nice.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很令人愉快。
words.en: If you say that something is nice, you mean that you find it attractive, pleasant, or enjoyable.

words.tr: adj. 滑稽的；好笑的；有趣的；
words.ex: The funny clown made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 那个滑稽的小丑让所有人都笑了。
words.en: Something that is funny is amusing and likely to make you laugh.

words.ex: He is a friendly boy who smiles at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个友好的男孩，对每个人都微笑。
words.en: If someone is friendly, they behave in a pleasant, kind way, and like to be with other people.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.ex: He is polite to everyone he meets.
words.ex_cn: 他对遇到的每个人都很有礼貌。
words.en: Having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people.

words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.ex: Be careful when you cross the street.
words.en: If you are careful, you give serious attention to what you are doing, in order to avoid harm, damage, or mistakes.

words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.en: If you are busy, you are working hard or giving your attention to a particular activity.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.tr: adj. 丰饶的；富有的；富裕的；
words.ex: The land is rich in minerals.
words.en: Having a great deal of money or assets; wealthy.

words.tr: adj. 拙劣的；贫穷的；缺少的；可怜的；
words.ex: The acting in that movie was poor.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影的表演很拙劣。
words.en: If you describe someone as poor, you mean that they do not have enough money to live on or that they have very little money.

words.ex: The child is hungry and cries for food.
words.en: Feeling or showing the need for food; having a strong desire or craving.

words.ex: He is thirsty after running.
words.en: If you are thirsty, you feel a need to drink something.

words.ex: She eats healthy food every day.
words.en: Someone who is healthy is well and is not suffering from any illness.

words.ex: He is strong enough to lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他很强壮，足以举起这个箱子。
words.en: Someone who is strong is healthy with good muscles and can move or carry heavy things, or do hard physical work.

words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.ex: The box is heavy.
words.en: Something that is heavy weighs a lot.

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.tr:
adj. 低沉的；低垂的；
adv. 低；低矮；在低处；往下地；
words.ex: He spoke in a low voice to avoid waking the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他用低沉的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If something is low, it is close to the ground, the bottom, or the base of something.

words.tr:
adj. 满的；充满的；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The glass is full of water.
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.tr:
adj. 早的；早前的；
adv. 提早地；
words.ex: He woke up early this morning.
words.en: Before the usual or expected time; at or near the beginning of a particular period or series of events.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.ex: The old man walks slowly in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在公园里慢慢走路。
words.en: Having lived or existed for a long time; no longer young or new.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.ex: We work together every day.
words.en: If people do something together, they do it with each other.

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.ex: The child is quiet during nap time.
words.en: Making little or no noise; free from disturbance or tumult; tranquil; calm.

words.ex: The children are noisy in the classroom.
words.en: A noisy place is full of a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds.

words.ex: The child is happy when he plays with his toys.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子玩玩具时，他很快乐。
words.en: If you are happy, you are feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.ex: He became angry when his phone broke.
words.ex_cn: 当他手机坏了时，他生气了。
words.en: Feeling or showing strong annoyance, displeasure, or hostility; full of anger.

words.tr: adj. 感到惊讶的； v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；“surprise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was surprised when I saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到礼物时，我感到很惊讶。
words.en: If you are surprised, you have a feeling of surprise, because something unexpected has happened.

words.tr: adj. 兴奋的； v. 使兴奋；使激动；“excite”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children were excited about the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们对派对感到兴奋。
words.en: If you are excited, you are so happy that you cannot relax, usually because you are thinking about something pleasant that you are going to do or experience.

words.tr: adj. 担忧的；焦虑的；发愁的； v. 担心；担忧；“worry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was worried about his test results.
words.ex_cn: 他担心自己的考试成绩。
words.en: If you are worried, you are unhappy because you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的；神经系统的；
words.ex: He felt nervous before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张不安。
words.en: If someone is nervous, they are frightened or worried about something that is happening or might happen, and show this in their behavior.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；正确的；
words.ex: The story is true.
words.en: in accordance with fact or reality

words.ex: The news was false.
words.en: If something is false, it is incorrect, untrue, or mistaken.

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: The singer sang a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在音乐会上唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A singer is a person who sings, especially as a profession.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: The actress sings in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位女演员在电影中唱歌。
words.en: An actress is a woman whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.tr: n. 运动员；选手；唱机；玩家；
words.ex: The player scored a goal in the final minute.
words.ex_cn: 这名运动员在最后一分钟进了一球。
words.en: A player is someone who takes part in a game or sport, or someone who performs in a theatrical production or musical performance.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: The driver stopped the car at the red light.
words.en: A driver is a person who drives a vehicle.

words.ex: I ween that he will come tomorrow.
words.en: To think or suppose something.

words.ex: He is among the best students in class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最好的学生之一。
words.en: If you are among a group of things or people, you are surrounded by them or part of them.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.tr:
conj. 虽然；尽管；然而；
adv. 虽然；尽管；可是；
words.ex: Though it was raining, he went out.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use though to introduce a statement in a subordinate clause which contrasts with the statement in the main clause. You often use though to introduce a fact which you regard as less important than the fact in the main clause.
